user.title: Set up BlueFire
user.description: Choose a nearby BLE device or enter its MAC address. BlueFire connects when the entry loads; J1708 startup commands require explicit opt-in.

discovered.title: Select your adapter
discovered.description: These are nearby connectable BLE devices. Compare the name and MAC address with your adapter before continuing. The receiver checks for the documented BlueFire EZ service after setup.

manual.title: Set up a BlueFire adapter
manual.description: The receiver subscribes to the documented BlueFire EZ telemetry characteristics after setup. MQTT and Bluetooth must be configured in Home Assistant. Adapter compatibility is not hardware-verified.

data_description.engine_profile: Select Detroit Series 60 / DDEC IV when identified by official equipment labels or documentation. Enables engine MID 128 names and Detroit diagnostic references; does not infer other controllers, installed options or calibration. Leave blank for standard J1587.
data_description.address: Use the adapter's Bluetooth MAC, not the host or proxy MAC. Colon-separated, hyphen-separated or 12 hexadecimal digits are accepted.
data_description.vehicle_id: 1–64 lowercase letters, digits, underscores or hyphens; start with a letter or digit.
data_description.j1587_extended: Select the adapter firmware format. Required for J1708 startup; otherwise leave blank to ignore J1587 PIDData.
data_description.j1708_startup: Send version, unsecured authentication, passive subscriptions and report-start commands, then actively request fuel level, diagnostic codes, odometer, engine hours and total fuel used every minute. Does not change adapter settings, clear faults, reset security or upgrade firmware. Secured adapters are not supported.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure BlueFire
reconfigure.description: Correct the adapter name or Bluetooth MAC address. This does not verify hardware compatibility. Your vehicle MQTT identifier and existing entities are preserved.

data_description.engine_profile: Select the engine identified by official equipment labels. Existing MQTT identities are preserved; Detroit references apply only to engine MID 128. Choose standard J1587 to remove the engine-specific interpretation.
data_description.address: Use the adapter's Bluetooth MAC, not the host or proxy MAC. Colon-separated, hyphen-separated or 12 hexadecimal digits are accepted.
data_description.j1587_extended: Select the adapter firmware format. Required for J1708 startup; firmware 3.23.0 uses Extended (3.19+).
data_description.j1708_startup: Opt in to unsecured authentication, passive monitoring and one-minute active reads of fuel level, diagnostics, odometer, engine hours and total fuel used, with failure backoff. Disabled entries remain receive-only. Does not clear faults or change security, bus settings or firmware.

error.invalid_address: Enter the adapter's individual Bluetooth MAC, such as AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF, AA-BB-CC-DD-EE-FF or AABBCCDDEEFF.
error.invalid_selection: Select a device from the list.
error.invalid_vehicle_id: Use 1–64 lowercase letters, digits, underscores or hyphens; start with a letter or digit.
error.invalid_j1587_format: Select a supported J1587 firmware format.
error.invalid_engine_profile: Select a supported engine profile or standard J1587.
error.required_j1587_format: Select the adapter firmware format before enabling J1708 startup.
error.vehicle_id_in_use: Another adapter already uses this vehicle MQTT identifier.

abort.no_devices_found: No unconfigured connectable BLE devices were found. Restart setup and choose manual MAC entry to prepare offline.

cleanup_mqtt.name: Clean up old MQTT entities
cleanup_mqtt.description: Preview owned MQTT entities not observed since this BlueFire reload. Turn off preview to withdraw their retained discovery and last-known states after broker confirmation. Let the vehicle report first; unseen does not mean invalid. Received entities and protocol diagnostics are preserved.

entry_id.name: Config entry
entry_id.description: The loaded BlueFire adapter whose MQTT entities should be reviewed.

dry_run.name: Preview only
dry_run.description: Enabled by default. Returns candidate topics without deleting anything. Disable to remove entities still unobserved when the action runs.

read_odometer.name: Read odometer
read_odometer.description: Send a one-shot J1708 PID 245 request and collect reports for five seconds. Updates existing MQTT total-distance sensors and returns kilometres per responding controller. Requires ready, opt-in J1708 startup. No response is an error; unavailable values remain null.

mid.name: Controller MID
mid.description: Optional controller MID 128–255; 128 is the engine, 130 the transmission. Omit or use 0 for all responding controllers.

entry_id.name: Config entry
entry_id.description: The connected BlueFire adapter to request total vehicle distance from.

read_engine_hours.name: Read engine hours
read_engine_hours.description: Send a one-shot J1708 PID 247 request and collect reports for five seconds. Updates existing MQTT total-engine-hours sensors and returns hours per responding controller. Requires ready, opt-in J1708 startup. No response is an error; unavailable values remain null.

mid.name: Controller MID
mid.description: Optional controller MID 128–255; omit or use 0 for all responding controllers.

entry_id.name: Config entry
entry_id.description: The connected BlueFire adapter to request total engine hours from.

read_total_fuel_used.name: Read total fuel used
read_total_fuel_used.description: Send a one-shot J1708 PID 250 request and collect reports for five seconds. Updates existing MQTT total-fuel-used sensors and returns litres per responding controller, not fuel remaining. Requires ready, opt-in J1708 startup. No response is an error; unavailable values remain null.

mid.name: Controller MID
mid.description: Optional controller MID 128–255; omit or use 0 for all responding controllers.

entry_id.name: Config entry
entry_id.description: The connected BlueFire adapter to request total fuel used from.

read_fuel_level.name: Read fuel level
read_fuel_level.description: Send a one-shot J1708 fuel-level request and collect reports for five seconds. Updates MQTT fuel sensors and returns percent readings per responding controller. Requires ready, opt-in J1708 startup. No response is an error; unavailable values remain null.

mid.name: Controller MID
mid.description: Optional controller MID 128–255; omit or use 0 for all responding controllers.

entry_id.name: Config entry
entry_id.description: The connected BlueFire adapter to request fuel level from.

read_diagnostic_codes.name: Read diagnostic codes
read_diagnostic_codes.description: Send a one-shot J1708 PID 194 request and collect reported active/inactive faults for five seconds. Updates MQTT diagnostic sensors and returns codes per responding controller. Requires ready, opt-in J1708 startup. Never clears faults; no response is not a clean bill of health.

mid.name: Controller MID
mid.description: Optional controller MID 128–255; omit or use 0 for all responding controllers.

entry_id.name: Config entry
entry_id.description: The connected BlueFire adapter to request diagnostic codes from.

read_parameter.name: Read J1587 parameter
read_parameter.description: Request one allowlisted measurement, status, diagnostic or identification PID for five seconds. Returns fresh data and updates supported MQTT entities. PID 174 fuel temperature returns raw bytes only. Never clears faults, programs the ECM or runs actuators. Requires ready J1708 startup; no response is an error, not proof a sensor is absent.

pid.name: J1587 PID
pid.description: Only PIDs in the documented read allowlist are accepted. Examples: 26 fan, 68 torque, 85 cruise, 162/163 gears, 184/185 economy, 235/236 idle totals, 439 extended boost. Arbitrary bus writes and fault-clearing PIDs are rejected.

mid.name: Controller MID
mid.description: Optional controller MID 128–255; omit or use 0 for all responding controllers.

read_software_identification.name: Read software identification
read_software_identification.description: Request PID 234 software identification. Returns controller-reported text, not an inferred calibration. Manual only; not added to periodic polling.

mid.name: Controller MID
mid.description: Use 128 for the engine, or omit/use 0 for all responding controllers.

read_vehicle_identification.name: Read vehicle identification
read_vehicle_identification.description: Request PID 237 vehicle identification. Returns the actual controller text even if it is not a valid VIN. Does not replace official equipment labels.

mid.name: Controller MID
mid.description: Use a controller MID 128–255, or omit/use 0 for all responding controllers.

read_component_identification.name: Read component identification
read_component_identification.description: Request PID 243 component identification. Validates/removes the BlueFire embedded MID wrapper where present and preserves reported make/model/serial text. Requires ready J1708 startup.

mid.name: Controller MID
mid.description: Use 128 for the engine, 130 for transmission, or omit/use 0 for all responding controllers.

inspect_adapter.name: Inspect adapter
inspect_adapter.description: Connect once and return GATT service/characteristic UUIDs and properties. Does not read telemetry, authenticate, or write BlueFire commands.

capture_notifications.name: Capture notifications
capture_notifications.description: Connect once, subscribe to every notify/indicate characteristic for a short window and return raw notification bytes with framing, parse, timing and signal-strength analysis. Does not read values, authenticate, or write BlueFire commands. Downloading diagnostics runs the same capture for 20 seconds.

entry_id.name: Config entry
entry_id.description: The BlueFire adapter to capture from.
